name: Engage 1 - Introduce Yourself
description: Introduce yourself to the class. Tell us your name, major, and one thing you hope to learn about generative AI this semester. Visit this prompting guide for context.

name: Engage 2 - First Prompt
description: Write a prompt that gets Claude (or your preferred LLM) to produce a useful summary of an article. Submit the prompt and the response. Note: GPT-4 specifics from last year no longer apply.

name: Engage 3 - Build an Agent
description: Use a tool-using agent framework to solve a small task.
